review_candidates.title: Chief Operating Officer
review_candidates.description: Position Overview The COO manages HRHA’s daily operations, supports and acts for the CEO, and oversees housing programs, projects, compliance, finances, contracts, and staff. The position also serves as EIV Coordinator, Section 504 Coordinator, and agency Hearing Officer. Key Responsibilities • Oversee 256 public housing units and 611 Housing Choice Vouchers, including occupancy, leasing, rent collection, inspections, re-certifications, resident services, and complaints. • Monitor PHAS and SEMAP performance, HUD reporting, capital funds, budgets, utilization, reserves, fees, and monthly financial results. • Manage agency projects, consultants, contractors, service contracts, schedules, budgets, and resources. • Ensure compliance with HUD rules, fair housing and accessibility laws, HRHA policies, and recordkeeping requirements. • Conduct applicant and participant reviews or hearings and manage accommodation, accessibility, and transfer requests. • Build partnerships with landlords, police, schools, social services, and other community organizations. • Produce program reports in Encompass and perform other assigned duties. Operational and Program Oversight The COO is responsible for keeping housing operations efficient, compliant, and responsive. For Public Housing, this includes monitoring rent collection, occupancy, leasing, work orders, resident counseling, complaint resolution, and compliance with HUD physical condition standards. For the Housing Choice Voucher program, the COO tracks voucher use, annual and interim recertification, housing quality inspections, and required participant records. The COO reviews performance under the Public Housing Assessment System and the Section Eight Management Assessment Program, identifies weaknesses, and directs corrective action when needed. The position also coordinates agency projects from approval through completion. This includes developing schedules, monitoring budgets, assigning staff and other resources, working with consultants and contractors, and maintaining project information in Basecamp. Service contracts must be reviewed for quality, adherence to specifications, timely renewal, and value to the agency. Compliance, Finance, and Resident Service The COO implements required HUD policies and confirms that programs meet federal reporting and recordkeeping standards. Financial oversight includes forecasting annual funding, reviewing monthly results, comparing actual costs with approved budgets, and monitoring program utilization, reserves, administrative fees, and capital fund spending. The COO audits leasing and occupancy files, documents findings, and follows up on needed corrections. As Section 504 Coordinator, the COO manages reasonable accommodation and transfer requests, evaluates accessibility needs, and updates the agency transition plan. As Hearing Officer, the COO conducts informal reviews and hearings when applicants or participants challenge an agency decision, ensuring that the process is fair, consistent, and properly documented. The role also maintains working relationships with landlords, law enforcement, schools, social service agencies, and community organizations that support residents and program participants. Supervisory Responsibilities Supervises Public Housing, Housing Choice Voucher, and Project-Based Voucher staff. Duties include hiring, training, assigning work, evaluating performance, addressing conduct and complaints, and resolving workplace problems. Leadership Expectations The COO sets clear expectations, delegates work appropriately, monitors results, and gives employees timely feedback. The role requires dependable follow-through, sound judgment, ethical conduct, and the ability to solve problems before they disrupt service. The COO should communicate clearly, listen carefully, keep the CEO and staff informed, and respond constructively to questions or concerns. Effective performance also requires teamwork, initiative, adaptability, continued professional development, and a staff-wide consistent focus on service to residents, participants, colleagues, and community partners. Required Qualifications • Bachelor’s degree in business administration, public administration, or a related field; master’s degree preferred. • Progressively responsible public housing, property management, or Housing Choice Voucher experience, including staff supervision. • Public Housing Manager certification preferred or required within two years; Housing Choice Voucher certification required within the same period. • Knowledge of federal housing rules, civil law, collections, fair housing, disability access laws, and HRHA policies. • Strong leadership, communication, problem-solving, planning, teamwork, accountability, initiative, and integrity. • Valid Virginia driver’s license and successful criminal background and drug screenings. Physical Demands and Work Environment The position frequently requires standing, walking, using hands and fingers, bending, stooping, kneeling, or crawling. It occasionally requires sitting and lifting, pushing, or carrying items up to 50 pounds. The employee must also use sufficient visual acuity to operate equipment, read technical information, and use a keyboard.

Build and maintain positive working relationships with stakeholders across Gamma, ensuring they are appropriately informed, supported and, that agreed actions are followed through. What You’ll Bring Confidence working with senior stakeholders and handling sensitive or confidential information appropriately. Demonstrable research and analytical capability, with the ability to turn information into clear conclusions and well-structured materials. Experience preparing presentations, reports, briefing papers or similar business materials. Strong Microsoft PowerPoint and Excel skills and confidence working with structured information and management data. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with strong attention to detail. Ability to manage multiple priorities, work independently within clear parameters and exercise judgement over when to resolve, challenge or escalate. Experience coordinating meetings, governance forums, planning processes, projects or cross-functional activity is desirable. Understanding of project delivery, business cases, investment governance, financial planning or benefits realisation is desirable. Experience in Telecoms, IT or Technology sectors is desirable. Relevant degree, apprenticeship, professional qualification or equivalent practical experience is desirable. What do we offer you? 25 days annual leave + birthday Subsidised private medical insurance 5.1% matched pension contributions Enhanced parental leave Life assurance and Income protection Share save and incentive plans Electric Vehicle and Cycle scheme Employee discounts Volunteer day A few things to note We require all candidates to be eligible to work in the UK and pass a basic DBS check. If you don’t meet every requirement but feel you could thrive in this role, we would still encourage you to apply. Gamma is an equal-opportunity employer committed to building diverse, inclusive teams where everyone feels valued and can be their authentic selves. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, especially those underrepresented in our industry. As a family-friendly employer, we foster a culture of trust, autonomy, and flexibility to support your work-life balance and help you thrive at Gamma. For recruitment agencies – we have a network of fantastic partners that support us in our hiring from time to time. We’re not looking to increase that network currently, so please don’t send speculative CVs.

If you've sold into data centers before, or you've built your career moving electrical, thermal, or industrial equipment into mission-critical environments, we want to hear from you. We're looking for someone hungry to solve problems for customers and excited to help us capture the growth we've got ahead of us. Project pipelines, procurement timelines, pain points, and decision-making structures that help us tailor our approach • Lead end-to-end business development, from market identification through deal structuring and contract execution • Support the proposal process by capturing customer context clearly enough that Project Delivery and other teams can build tailored, high-quality proposals • Partner with our Communications & Brand team to develop visual assets and materials tailored to each client's specific requirements • Drive strategic outbound prospecting and pipeline generation to identify and engage new opportunities in the data center space • Build momentum and confidence with prospective clients to move them into discovery with our technical experts • Represent NGEN at industry conferences, trade shows, and client-facing events • Stay close to clients throughout their lifecycle with us, well beyond the deal closing YOU'LL WIN US OVER WITH THIS KNOWLEDGE & EXPERIENCE: • You bring 5+ years of experience in business development, sales, or strategic partnerships, with meaningful, senior-level exposure to the data center industry • You've sold into data centers before, or you've sold electrical, thermal, or OFCI equipment into industrial accounts, some of which happen to be data centers • You understand, at least conversationally, thermal and electrical infrastructure, including equipment like e-houses, transformers, switchgear, and modular power skids • Experience in construction, project management, or the design and engineering side of data center development is a strong asset, but not a strict requirement • You've contributed to complex, multi-department proposal processes • You have excellent communication and interpersonal skills, comfortable engaging C-level stakeholders and technical decision-makers alike • Familiarity with CRM tools (Salesforce, HubSpot) and sales enablement platforms WHO YOU ARE: • You're a self-starter who thrives in a remote, fast-paced environment • You operate with ownership. If a deal doesn't go your way, you look at what you could've done differently, not just what got in the way • You're action-oriented. You'd rather move something forward today and adjust tomorrow than wait for the perfect plan • You're collaborative and you want your team to win with you • You're flexible when client meetings or time zones call for hours outside the typical nine-to-five • You're excited by the idea of helping shape how the data center industry gets the power and cooling infrastructure it needs, at a moment when demand for it has never been higher COMPENSATION PACKAGE: • U.S. base salary: $115,000 - $145,000 USD • Canada base salary: $125,000 - $155,000 CAD • The exact salary will be determined based on the selected candidate's location, qualifications, experience, and relevant skills • Annual bonus of up to 25% of your base salary, based on • 401k or RRSP match of up to 5% of your base salary • Access to health, dental, and vision benefits for you and your dependents • Three weeks of paid vacation • Five paid personal days • Home office set-up support • Remote working environment with flexibility and autonomy INTERVIEW PROCESS & TIMELINES: We're so excited that you are interested in joining our team! Our interview process will look like this: • Oct 26-30th: 4-6 questions emailed to shortlisted candidates, confirming some basic information about you and why you're interested in this position (estimated time commitment 10-15 minutes) • Nov 2-6th: 30-minute virtual meeting with our recruitment team so that we can learn more about your career path so far, and you have a chance to ask us any questions that you have • Nov 9-13th: 1-hour meeting with the Head of Business Development and a member of the People & Culture team • Nov 16-20th: Reference checks and an employment offer extended We will do our best to follow the timelines outlined, and we will let you know if timelines shift! HOW WE THINK ABOUT AI IN RECRUITMENT: We believe in real humans hiring real humans. • To keep things organized and thoughtful, NGEN uses AI-assisted tools for notetaking during interviews. That said, every conversation, evaluation, and hiring decision is made by real people on our team (including initial resume screening). The only automated (not AI-augmented, just automated) step in our process is at the initial screening question stage when you're first applying for the role. • We are so excited to meet you and hear about all the incredible experiences and expertise you have built throughout your career. It's very important to us that we hear about those experiences and pieces of expertise in your own words – we prefer messy and authentic to polished with no depth. We mention this because we know how tight the labor market is and why some candidates may feel compelled to use an AI companion tool to help them answer questions live in interviews. Please be aware that if we suspect that you are using a tool like this, we will stop the interview and remove your application from consideration. We do believe in using AI to support our everyday work in areas that we've identified as low value or low energy – we routinely use tools like Claude, Zapier, Fireflies.ai and Grammarly. Bringing on a new teammate is very important to us, so this effort falls into neither of those categories of “low value” or “low energy”. We will show up for you in this recruitment process! In turn, please show up (as you!) for us. We can't wait to meet you! HOW TO APPLY: If this role sounds like it's right up your alley, but you're worried about missing a few of the qualifications, please reach out with your interest anyway. We value the unique skill sets, experiences, and pathways that people take in their careers, and are aware that non-traditional routes are sometimes overlooked. We make hiring decisions based on skill, and we're excited to hear what you will bring to our team! • This is a permanent, full-time position and a fully remote role with some travel required • We are not in a position to sponsor visa applications of any kind. As a result, only candidates who are currently legally entitled to work in the USA and/or Canada will be considered for this role • This position will typically work Monday to Friday within the normal business hours of the region in which the successful candidate lives. As a member of a globally remote team, some meetings outside of normal business hours will be required for this role Please submit a resume and cover letter to careers@ngen-mc.com with the subject ‘ Business Development Executive, Data Centers .’ We thank all applicants for their interest; however, only those candidates selected for interviews will be contacted.
